method: Reviewed all 57 declaration records in both source files against current published mechanisms. Added the few unquoted DTOs and exact identity/type-guard contracts. SDK response-hook caller was independently located and read. Overload declarations remain separate QA records while sharing one runtime function.

entry_updates.mechanism_append: `emitSessionShutdownEvent(runner, event)` returns false when there are no session_shutdown handlers; otherwise it awaits the existing generic emitter and returns true. True means emission was attempted, not that every handler succeeded, since normal handler errors are handled by emit. The SDK's provider onResponse callback likewise looks up the current runner, skips absent after_provider_response handlers, and awaits generic emission with status and headers. Supported provider adapters call this hook after response headers and before consuming the body; return values do not replace the response (ice:packages/coding-agent/src/core/extensions/runner.ts:212-221; ice:packages/coding-agent/src/core/sdk.ts:353-362).
entry_updates.interfaces_append: Exact additional DTOs: `SessionStartEvent { type: 'session_start'; reason: 'startup' | 'reload' | 'new' | 'resume' | 'fork'; previousSessionFile?: string }`; `SessionCompactEvent { type: 'session_compact'; compactionEntry: CompactionEntry; fromExtension: boolean; reason: 'manual' | 'threshold' | 'overflow'; willRetry: boolean }`; `SessionShutdownEvent { type: 'session_shutdown'; reason: 'quit' | 'reload' | 'new' | 'resume' | 'fork'; targetSessionFile?: string }`; `SessionTreeEvent { type: 'session_tree'; newLeafId: string | null; oldLeafId: string | null; summaryEntry?: BranchSummaryEntry; fromExtension?: boolean }`. `SessionEvent` is the union of these records, SessionInfoChangedEvent, and the four before-event types already quoted. `AfterProviderResponseEvent { type: 'after_provider_response'; status: number; headers: Record<string,string> }` is a response-header notification (ice:packages/coding-agent/src/core/extensions/types.ts:616-717; ice:packages/coding-agent/src/core/extensions/types.ts:746-750).

entry_updates.mechanism_append: `defineTool(tool)` returns the identical descriptor reference through a TypeScript intersection cast to `ToolDefinition & AnyToolDefinition`. It neither clones nor registers the tool and performs no runtime validation; the object-schema check remains in registerTool (ice:packages/coding-agent/src/core/extensions/types.ts:563-567).

entry_updates.interfaces_append: `SessionInfoChangedEvent { type: 'session_info_changed'; name: string | undefined }` uses a required name property whose value may be undefined when cleared. The named action aliases at types.ts:1640-1644 and types.ts:1667 have the same generic append/void name-and-label signatures already quoted (ice:packages/coding-agent/src/core/extensions/types.ts:625-629; ice:packages/coding-agent/src/core/extensions/types.ts:1640-1644; ice:packages/coding-agent/src/core/extensions/types.ts:1667).

Minimal lifecycle schemas also include `AgentStartEvent { type: 'agent_start' }`, `AgentSettledEvent { type: 'agent_settled' }` and `MessageStartEvent { type: 'message_start'; message: AgentMessage }`. The settled marker carries no additional DTO fields; scheduling and retry completion remain runtime-owned (ice:packages/coding-agent/src/core/extensions/types.ts:766-779; ice:packages/coding-agent/src/core/extensions/types.ts:797-800).

entry_updates.mechanism_append: The seven `is*ToolResult` helpers compare only `event.toolName` to the corresponding exact built-in name. They do not inspect event.type, input, content or details, and therefore must not be treated as validation or an authorization gate. Built-in result subtypes specialize the common ToolResultEventBase: bash/read/edit/grep/find/ls use their respective Details type or undefined, write has details:undefined, and CustomToolResultEvent has toolName:string with details:unknown (ice:packages/coding-agent/src/core/extensions/types.ts:978-1049).

All seven built-in `isToolCallEventType` overloads plus the custom generic overload share one implementation: return `event.toolName === toolName`. The custom overload only asserts a compile-time `{ toolName: TName; input: TInput }` intersection; it does not validate custom arguments. The nine QA declaration records are overloads plus one implementation, not nine independent runtime functions (ice:packages/coding-agent/src/core/extensions/types.ts:1072-1085).

entry_updates.interfaces_append: `ExtensionHandler<E, R = undefined> = (event: E, ctx: ExtensionContext) => Promise<R | void> | R | void`. `ExtensionEvent` is the union of ProjectTrustEvent, ResourcesDiscoverEvent, SessionEvent, ContextEvent, BeforeProviderRequestEvent, BeforeProviderHeadersEvent, AfterProviderResponseEvent, BeforeAgentStartEvent, AgentStartEvent, AgentEndEvent, AgentSettledEvent, TurnStartEvent, TurnEndEvent, MessageStartEvent, MessageUpdateEvent, MessageEndEvent, ToolExecutionStartEvent, ToolExecutionUpdateEvent, ToolExecutionEndEvent, ModelSelectEvent, ThinkingLevelSelectEvent, UserBashEvent, InputEvent, ToolCallEvent and ToolResultEvent. These declarations do not add event-name validation to the runtime string-keyed map (ice:packages/coding-agent/src/core/extensions/types.ts:1088-1113; ice:packages/coding-agent/src/core/extensions/types.ts:1249).

`RefreshToolsHandler = () => void`. `ExtensionRuntimeState` holds flagValues:Map<string,boolean|string>; pendingProviderRegistrations:Array<{name,config,extensionPath}>; pendingNativeProviderRegistrations:Array<{provider,extensionPath}>; assertActive:()=>void; invalidate:(message?:string)=>void; registerProvider:(name,config,extensionPath?)=>void; registerNativeProvider:(provider,extensionPath?)=>void; unregisterProvider:(name,extensionPath?)=>void. The callback/state declarations do not change the pre-bind queue and first-stale-cause semantics already described (ice:packages/coding-agent/src/core/extensions/types.ts:1659; ice:packages/coding-agent/src/core/extensions/types.ts:1673-1692).
